Will show you behind the scenes of what @hormozi called the naked funnel and a whole lot more.

Public apology:⁠
⁠
For years, I taught that once your offer went over $2k… you needed a sales call.⁠
⁠
Under $2k? Sure, sell it with a doc, a webinar, whatever.⁠
⁠
Over $2k? “Better get the closers in.”⁠
⁠
Turns out… that was complete rubbish.⁠
⁠
A client of mine had a $30k offer being sold in chat by VAs with their thumbs… while the “real” sales team was busy having feelings about it.⁠
⁠
That was the moment the penny dropped.⁠
⁠
If someone can sell a $30k offer without a call…⁠
⁠
maybe the call wasn’t the magic.⁠
⁠
Maybe the system was broken.⁠
⁠
So we tested it.⁠
⁠
Locked the sales team away.⁠
⁠
No calls.⁠
⁠
No chats.⁠
⁠
No closing.⁠
⁠
Nothing.⁠
⁠
15 months later?⁠
⁠
We’re selling 5x more every month than we did with a full sales team.⁠
⁠
That’s Salesless™.⁠
⁠
Comment SALESLESS for the deets.

You’ve got 3 options:⁠
⁠
Option A: stay in sales call prison forever.⁠
⁠
Option B: hire a team and accidentally become the manager of a sad little call centre.⁠
⁠
Option C: build a Salesless™ system that lets people buy without calls.⁠
⁠
A and B are available.⁠
⁠
C is better.⁠
⁠
Despite what the sales douches say, this works.⁠
⁠
Not just for me.⁠
⁠
For clients too.⁠
⁠
Hundreds of them.⁠
⁠
And yes, one of the guys publicly bagging it had privately asked me to help him fix his mess.⁠
⁠
We built the doc.⁠
⁠
He made 3 x $30k sales in 12 hours.⁠
⁠
Awkward.⁠
⁠
If you want to see how the full system works — doc, demand, deadline — comment SALESLESS.

viral_posts.hook: You do not need a “content day.”⁠
viral_posts.caption:
You do not need a “content day.”⁠
⁠
You need a content radar.⁠
⁠
Because the good stuff doesn’t clock in when you’re ready.⁠
⁠
It shows up when life does.⁠
⁠
A conversation.⁠
⁠
A lesson.⁠
⁠
A screenshot.⁠
⁠
A client win.⁠
⁠
A weird thought in the car.⁠
⁠
A moment that reveals something true.⁠
⁠
That’s where the gold is.⁠
⁠
Not in forcing ideas.⁠
⁠
In catching them.

viral_posts.hook: If your client keeps asking for more calls… ⁠
viral_posts.caption:
If your client keeps asking for more calls… ⁠
⁠
but hasn’t done the work from the last one… ⁠
⁠
that’s not coaching. That’s babysitting.⁠
⁠
Here’s the fix:⁠
⁠
At the end of the call, get them clear on the next 3 steps.⁠
⁠
Then say:⁠
⁠
“Getting those 3 actions done is your ticket to our next call.”⁠
⁠
Because your calendar is not a daycare centre for people avoiding execution.⁠
⁠
More calls won’t create momentum.⁠
⁠
More action will.⁠
⁠
And weirdly enough, clients tend to respect your time a whole lot more when you do too.⁠
⁠
Follow for more coaching, marketing, and delivery tips that make your business better and your life easier.
